children: Cipher announced a 10-year commitment that extends Barber Lake’s contracted life to 20 years and adds about $5.2 billion of incremental contracted revenue.
Executed amendment and binding commitment that extend Barber Lake leased term to 20 years.
New 10-year lease with a leading AI lab is expected to add approximately $5.2 billion of contracted revenue.
Total contracted revenue at Barber Lake rises from $3.8 billion to over $9 billion.
Phased delivery: data halls to be delivered Q4 2026 through Q1 2027; rent starts as each hall is delivered.
Cipher will absorb first $359.3 million of cost overruns; tenant reimburses 50% of excess over that amount as additional rent over 20 years.

title: Cipher expands Barber Lake lease to 20 years, adds ~$5.2B incremental contracted revenue
